comparison.objective: Capture a reference angle with a bevel gauge, carry it unchanged and draw the transferred line; candidate transfers a bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record adjusts a passive hinge, preserves its angle during transport and guides a marker. Candidate aligns rigid rail/jig profiles and performs force-limited sliding with free-ball containment.
comparison.success_condition: Record grades reference fit, angle retention, line accuracy/coverage and absence of stray marks. Candidate grades complete block transfer and preservation of every rolling element without separation or damage.
comparison.reason: Geometric measurement transfer and marking do not overlap with bearing-block support transfer.
